## Where Rainbows Hide

_by Rae Stoltenkamp_

The photo to the right show Rae holding the kindle edition, with the cover in the top-right photo, then the gratitude right under the dedication with my name in there. Rae's smile pretty much says everything. Everything that needs to be said.

  

To tell the story on how we got to "Where Rainbows Hide", we need to back up a bit. When traveling around, no matter whether in a van or hitchhiking, I look for places where I can volunteer. In Seattle, that was some improve clean-up following the 6.8 Nisqually Earthquake just a day after the Mardi Gras riots -- which, I was there, I can tell you that the cops fucking started that shit! In Council Bluffs, Iowa, it was cleaning up after an F4 and handing out food to survivors. In Florida, it was saving key deer who'd been stranded and even swept out to see after Hurricane Harvey. Those are just larger ones.

  

In April, 2014, Disco Lama sent my blood-sister and me an email talking about how the gift economy was spreading online, linking us to the (now-defunct) Impossible dot Com website. I flipped through some of the ideas and things that people were asking for.. . and came across a plea to help with a book cover.

  

This is how I met Rae Stoltenkamp, who's book concept on how we trade too much... far too much in the name of safety.. it grabbed me. I wanted to be a part in helping make it happen. She ran her concept by me and I got to work. In fact, I made a few different versions of the cover. At first she went with the "blue skies" version that you see above, but later even she herself went with a more dimmed version... which more nearly matched my "dark twilight" version that you'll see here below.

  

\[[Where Rainbows Hide on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Where-Rainbows-Hide-Rainbow-Quest/dp/1537696068/)\]

## Book One in the Rainbow Quest

When Rae released it in August, 2015, it made a big enough impact that it later went into a second edition, then even made it to paperback. I hope the message inside it reaches readers, that it helps them discover their own inner light and colors.

content.text: ## Book One in the Rainbow Quest When Rae released it in August, 2015, it made a big enough impact that it later went into a second edition, then even made it to paperback. I hope the message inside it reaches readers, that it helps them discover their own inner light and colors. ### Where Corrections Are Due I don't want the story above to mislead anyone. I have a rule to leave any place I touch better than when I entered it and whenever possible. I seek out creative spirits and those truly in need. That doesn't make me altruistic, nor a "nice" person. I am still the same person who handed the knife to a friend threatening suicide, the same person who then helped another friend plot out their own suicide. I've planned out and enacted revenge more than five times in this life and I didn't regret shit! I LOVED IT!! And for two of those, I fucking SAVORED IT and, even now, my mouth waters and heart races just remembering how sweet it was. Make no mistake in the demon behind these words, but do not be blinded by either the dark nor the light as to miss the other side of what I truly am. ### Extended Exploration My art and fractal designs appear on books, in video games, and of course on album art. You can find a handful of [these cover designs here](cover-art-others). If you want to see some of the nearest and dearest designs, that would definitely be "[R.E.M](rem)" as well as "[Days and Times of Power](days-and-times-of-power)". Really though, most of these covers come from my exploration of [surreal fractalscapes](other-fractalscapes). _The horizon is yours!_
